title: Recognized as an Impact Maker for Project Elevate
summary: Chad Malone presented the Impact Makers recognition during an IEN all-hands for colleagues in Europe and India. The slide credited AI-supported investment decisions and delivery, including a Codebeamer pilot with a development cycle up to 50% shorter and projected efficiency gains of up to 70% in AI test-automation pilots.
what_would_have_happened: The value from AI investment and delivery work across business units would be harder to compare without shared reporting.
the_call: Use AI to strengthen innovation investment decisions and delivery through Project Elevate.
what_i_did: Applied AI through Project Elevate and demonstrated project savings across investment and delivery pilots.
what_changed: Chad Malone recognized the work as an Impact Maker during the IEN all-hands. The award slide reported 13 of 14 business units engaged with Project Elevate, 11 using the Business Case AI Agent, and 9 using the Business Case Dashboard.
